column2: Setup: Create an S3 bucket with two folders — /raw and /curated. Upload sample CSV data into /raw.
Redshift Setup: Use Redshift Serverless with a workgroup and namespace. Configure an IAM role to allow access to S3 and Glue.
Glue Crawler for Raw Data: Run a Glue crawler to catalog the raw S3 data into the Glue Data Catalog database.
Source: Raw dataset from Glue Catalog.
Select only required columns (e.g., movieId, title, genres).
Split genres column into multiple rows or normalize it.
Apply filters (e.g., exclude null or empty titles).
Target: Write the transformed dataset back to the /curated/ folder in S3 in Parquet format.
Glue Crawler for Curated Data: Catalog the curated dataset into the same Glue database.
External Schema in Redshift: Create an external schema linked to the Glue Data Catalog.
Query curated table to confirm transformed structure.
Perform analytics queries, e.g., count movies per genre, list top genres, etc.
